sourceStatement: ASME B36.10-2022, Table 2-1. Verification method documented per record (owner decision 2026-10-06).

records.sourceDocument: botopsteelpipe.com — ASME B36.10M pipe dimension chart, Schedule 40 table (cross-checked vs Wheatland Tube Sch 40 submittal)
